$comment: Streams captured from claude 2.1.301 (native claude.exe, Windows 11, subscription login) for #17 and ADR 0042. Each run: the common arguments, then the case's own; the prompt on stdin, no prompt argument; cwd is a scratch git repository. Paths are replaced with C:\work\brewery\worktree and rate-limit utilisation with 0.5; nothing else is changed.

cases.stdin: Reply with exactly the word: ok
cases.shows: init with the session id given by --session-id; one assistant text; rate_limit_event; result/success

cases.stdin: What exact word did you reply with in your previous message? Answer with that word only.
cases.shows: --resume keeps the session id and the conversation; usage covers this run only, total_cost_usd both runs

cases.stdin: First read note.txt with the Read tool. Then run `git status` with the Bash tool. Then reply with only the word that note.txt names.
cases.shows: Read tool_use and tool_result; a bare deny (Bash) removes the tool, so its call is an is_error tool_result and not a permission denial; system/thinking_tokens; num_turns 3

cases.stdin: Do these three steps in order, each with one tool call, and do not retry a step that is refused: 1. Write the file out.txt containing the text x, with the Write tool. 2. Run `git push origin main` with the Bash tool. 3. Run `git status` with the Bash tool. Then reply with one line per step saying whether it was allowed.
cases.shows: system/permission_denied for a tool outside the allowlist (decision_reason_type mode) and for a scoped deny rule (subcommandResults); result.permission_denials lists both; the run still ends in result/success with exit 0

cases.stdin: Read note.txt with the Read tool and reply with only the word it names.
cases.shows: result/error_max_turns, is_error true, terminal_reason max_turns, errors ['Reached maximum number of turns (1)'], num_turns 2

cases.stdin: Reply with exactly the word: ok
cases.shows: an assistant message with error model_not_found; result subtype success but is_error true, terminal_reason api_error
